_comment: Not a live config file — Vercel only reads vercel.json. This is kept ready for a Vercel plan upgrade (Phase 10 Part 0.5, docs/admin/CRON_INCIDENT.md). Restoring real Vercel Cron is a one-file change: copy the 'crons' array below into vercel.json and deploy. NOTE: this is 12 entries — check the target plan's cron-COUNT limit (not just whether cron is supported at all) before restoring all of them at once; Vercel's lower tiers cap both the number of cron jobs and the minimum interval (e.g. daily-only, no hourly/15-minute schedules) as well as whether cron is available at all. Until this is restored, every one of these 12 jobs is served by lib/platform/scheduler/ instead — see docs/admin/SCHEDULED_WORK.md.
